On ${CUSTOM.name}, the timeline is ${lcfirst(CUSTOM.timeline)}.`, 106 }, 107 { 108 q: "Is there a lock-in contract?", 109 a: `On Starter, no. On Custom, care has a 12-month minimum, then runs month to month.
